title: Enterprise Connectivity: unallocated remittance order
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following unallocated remittance order for each named contract tier. Default allocation of an unspecified remittance; deterministic string.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | unallocated remittance order | invoice issue time followed by source-event reference |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | unallocated remittance order | invoice issue time followed by source-event reference |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | unallocated remittance order | invoice issue time followed by source-event reference |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | unallocated remittance order | invoice issue time followed by source-event reference |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | unallocated remittance order | invoice issue time followed by source-event reference |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | unallocated remittance order | invoice issue time followed by source-event reference |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the unallocated remittance order is invoice issue time followed by source-event reference.
